evidence_conventions.measured_donor_fact: Latin-reference facts from data/params.json only; no original Cyrillic exists in that reference.
evidence_conventions.source_reported_study: Existing metrics and preserved design-notes.md statements are previous study evidence; source-reported checks were not rerun by this passport task. Current README files carry present selection status and navigation.
evidence_conventions.measured_export_this_pass: Read-only inspection of existing TTF and WOFF2 using installed fontTools. Stored glyf bounding boxes, true curve extrema and hmtx LSB are different quantities and remain distinct.
evidence_conventions.existing_study_design_decision: Numbers chosen/transformed for a new study, even when they agree with a measured donor; not asserted as native source measurements.
evidence_conventions.instruction_prescription: Ductus from docs/instruction.md, not retrospective proof that an existing study was generated after recording those strokes.
evidence_conventions.selection: Explicit current task state and retained selection/progress records govern approval. Technical defaults do not resolve open choices.
evidence_conventions.path_base: All retained-artifact paths are repository-relative. Trial TTF/WOFF2/Glyphs are cumulative studies, not separate standalone production glyph/font releases.

verification.complete_geometric_proof: not performed; source sampling reports are not analytic proofs
verification.kerning: inherited positioning is provisional; dedicated new Cyrillic/mixed pairs remain open
